newsitem.title: USA: Pegasus files for preferred shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Pegasus files for preferred shr offering.

text.p: Pegasus Communications Corp said on Tuesday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a $100 million preferred stock and warrant offering.
Proceeds of the offering will be used to fund acquisitions, to repay debt under the company's credit facility and for general corporate purposes, Pegasus said.
CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp is the lead underwriter for this offering, Pegasus said. Lehman Brothers Inc and BT Securities Corp are co-managers for the offering, the company said.
